summary: H3 model wiring split out from the research card. Created blocked: the licence gate (MPI-451) must land first, and whether the authorization reaches end users in excluded territories is still unconfirmed.

Also still unwritten, not merely unverified: the licensors verbatim NOTICE string, the Powered by MiniMax H3 attribution, and a card preview clip inside the 124-362 trained frame range (the shipped one is this sessions 56-frame test render).

Three of the four unwritten deliverables written and verified; the fourth (a preview clip inside the 124-362 trained range) folds into the generation pass because it needs a run anyway. The agreement was re-read verbatim from MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3/raw/main/LICENSE (17604 bytes) rather than recalled, and the per-clause table now lives in docs/models/h3/README.md - most of Section III turns out to be ENCOURAGED, not owed, and Section III.2 does not bind us at all since we modify no weights. Section III.4 NOTICE shipped as licences/minimax-h3/NOTICE.txt, copied from the agreement's own line 33. The link-vs-bundle question is settled BY THE LICENCE, not by preference: Section III.1 obliges a copy to anyone who receives the Works OR USES YOUR PRODUCTS OR SERVICES RELATED THERETO, which reaches every Vision user who runs H3, and a link to huggingface.co names a copy rather than providing one - so licenceUrl is now root-relative at /licences/minimax-h3/LICENSE.txt, byte-identical to what the publisher serves, and openExternal resolves a root-relative url against location.href (the port is CUBRIC_PORT and cannot be hardcoded). Powered by MiniMax H3 ships as a poweredBy field rendered in the Model Library detail drawer beside the licence name - placed on the MODEL rather than app-wide because Section III.3.a scopes the notice to a product DEVELOPED USING H3, which is the model entry, not Vision. Proved, not assumed: the real server.js on CUBRIC_PORT=3977 serves both files 200 at 17604 and 121 bytes, the served line 33 matches NOTICE.txt exactly, the real shouldExcludeAppPath from build-portable.mjs returns shipped for all four paths, and npm test is 459/459. tests/licence-gate.test.cjs pinned licenceUrl to ^https:// - the exact assumption Section III.1 overturns - and now accepts a root-relative path AND stats it on disk, because a typo would open a 404 and silently discharge nothing. Two findings folded in rather than carded: MpiAppLibrary's drawer has no licence row so an app built on a gated model would show no attribution (documented in docs/playbooks/add-app/01-descriptor-and-ops.md, not built, since no app uses H3), and MPI-449 research line 377 assigned an i2v aspect fix to THIS card that never reached the checklist - first_frame gets crop=disabled so a source whose aspect misses the canvas is squashed into every frame. Test i2v with a 1:1 source on the 864x480 canvas; a 16:9 source passes and hides it. Still unverified: everything through the app.

i2v aspect concern raised and CLOSED the same day - recorded so it is not re-chased. MPI-449 research line 377 is right about the node (MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo gives first_frame a plain stretch via _resize disabled, last_frame an aspect-preserving center crop) and concluded MPI-452 must fit the first frame before dispatch. The shipped graph already does, which the research predates: nodes 218 and 220 are ImageResizeKJv2 with keep_proportion crop, crop_position center, divisible_by 32, sitting in front of BOTH frame paths and taking width/height from 167/168 - the same pair feeding every H3 node's canvas. Each frame therefore reaches the node at canvas size and the node's stretch is WxH to WxH, a no-op. The only way it could return is a canvas the resize cannot hit exactly, so that was checked too: all 15 MINIMAX_H3_RATIOS entries are divisible by 32, matching divisible_by 32 on the resize nodes and CANVAS_MULTIPLE 32 in the node source. No mismatch reachable. DO NOT add app-side aspect fitting - it would crop twice. Also note the crop literals are NOT in the workflow JSON and not in MpiNodes: they are hardcoded in core ComfyUI comfy_extras/nodes_minimax_h3.py, which /engine/upgrade wipes, so a node-side fix was never an option anyway. Recorded in docs/models/h3/README.md. Separately: Apps are being renamed FLOWS repo-wide by a parallel agent, which will sweep the add-app playbook block written earlier today.

Highest-risk steps are 6 (preview to Continue, the only path driving the a6e5d5e node fix through the app's own latent staging) and 5 (i2v, which has no op boolean - routing derives from media presence, so if Input_Start_Frame is not populated the graph takes the t2v branch and returns a perfectly good video that ignored the image). Step 3 covers the licence UI written today, whose file serving and portable staging are already proved - only the rendering is unverified. The runbook also lists four behaviours that will read as bugs and are not, the sharpest being that installing minimax-h3-ref2va later shows NO licence dialog because receipts are keyed by licence id rather than model id.

App run 1: checklist steps 1-3 PASS. Tile, trade table (DISK 53.2 GB), licence gate ordering, both required checkboxes, and the licence row written today (name + Powered by MiniMax H3 + all three links) all render correctly; the 0.61 GB audio VAE downloaded from the publisher URL in 14 s with no mirror rewrite. Three defects followed, NONE in the H3 wiring. A: Download Failed came from the curated pip pass, which must replace a package the RUNNING engine has imported - WinError 5 Access is denied on cv2/cv2.pyd, pip exit 1. Not transient and not self-healing because .cubric_python_deps is stamped only on success and was genuinely absent (engine upgraded in place last session), so every later model install would repeat it; a fresh engine is immune since cv2.pyd does not exist yet to be locked, making the trigger a release that MOVES a python dep pin plus a live engine. Carded MPI-459 as a structural install-path fix and deliberately NOT patched at the crash site. Confirmed by cure: engine stopped, identical pip command succeeded replacing 10 packages including opencv-contrib-python-headless-5.0.0.93; marker stamped at engine/.cubric_python_deps = 9985e35fa0c6db61; engine restarted and all H3 plus MpiNodes classes verified on /object_info (1870 total). B FIXED: the error dialog rendered blank because of a DOUBLE broadcast - _runCustomNodeInstall emits download:failed with the reason, throws the same text, and the catch re-emitted without it, so the later event clobbered the good one. Same defect MPI-387 fixed for the dep-level branch, never swept to this call site; now carries err.message. Server code, so it needs a full app restart not Ctrl+R. C FIXED: 404 on minimax_h3_preview.webp - MpiTileSheet derives a poster by the foo.mp4 to foo.webp convention and every other video model ships one while H3 did not; generated 480x266 via ffmpeg-static to match the 480px-wide convention, and it must be regenerated alongside the new clip in step 8. Lint clean, npm test 459/459. Resume at step 4.

Checklist steps 4 and 7 PASS. t2v at very_low 16:9 (608x352), 5 s requested, 2 m 56 s from cold. The expensive risk is closed: all 16 Input_* titles landed in the DISPATCHED graph read off /queue - duration, width/height, seed, prompt, both frame strings, both booleans and all six LoRA slots - so injection skipped nothing silently. Graph drift is zero: 64 nodes dispatched equals 64 shipped, nothing added or missing, which also clears the worry that a bench-authored node only worked because the ComfyUI browser prunes muted nodes. All four H3 branches survive (133 t2v, 275 start, 285 start+end, 304 end) and with both frame strings empty the run correctly took 133. The latent naming trap holds: Output_Video_Latent on MpiSaveLatent, no title containing audio for _latentRoleFromTitle to mis-tag. Progress read 1/2 then 2/2 live, confirming PROGRESS_STAGES single 2. The frame grid now proved through the app, not just the bench: Duration 00:00:05.17 at 24 fps is 124 frames, the predicted n mod 17 == 5 snap from a 5 s request and the bottom of the 124-362 trained range. Output carries Video h264 High 608x352 24 fps plus Audio aac LC 32000 Hz stereo 128 kb/s from one sampler pass, and the user confirmed the gallery plays it with nothing re-muxing on save, which closes step 7 too. Six LoRA slots render with both Model and Clip strengths. Remaining: step 5 i2v, step 6 preview to Continue, step 8 preview clip.

Step 6 root-caused and FIXED. Preview to Continue was DEAD ON ARRIVAL for H3: every preview toasted 'Preview latent missing - running full workflow to finish', got a COLD badge, and re-ran the whole workflow, so the finished video was a DIFFERENT sample than the one approved and Projects/H3/Media/.latents stayed empty (user-confirmed on disk). Root cause is saveLatentNodeIds in js/services/commandExecutor.js, which matched only class_type SaveLatent or a title equal to savelatent. H3's node is class_type MpiSaveLatent titled Output_Video_Latent and matched NEITHER, so the set was empty, the has(nodeId) guard never fired, _collectComfyLatents was never called, previewAssets.latent arrived with no filename and _materializeLatent returned status missing. The fleet looked healthy because all 12 LTX and 4 WAN graphs use core SaveLatent; minimax_h3_fl2va.json is the ONLY graph using MpiSaveLatent, since H3 packs video and audio into one NestedTensor that crashes core SaveLatent. Blast radius H3 only. This was MPI-452's own half-wire: a6e5d5e fixed the NODE half of the two-stage contract (report ui.latents, verified live in the engine's symlinked copy) and the APP half was never swept - exactly what the ROOT-CAUSE RULE's sweep-the-blast-radius clause exists to catch. Fixed by adding the MpiSaveLatent class and pinned by a new tests/save-latent-recognition.test.cjs (3 tests) that sweeps every shipped workflow for any class matching savelatent, guards the mirror against predicate drift, and re-pins H3's no-audio-in-the-latent-title trap. Negative control: under the OLD predicate exactly one node fleet-wide is unrecognised, minimax_h3_fl2va.json node 171. Lint clean, suite 462/462. NOT yet re-tested in the app - that is the next session's first job, and existing COLD previews must be deleted first because status missing is baked into each item's sidecar at save time. A wrong hypothesis was recorded and killed: that a fixed-name save plus fs.move interacted with ComfyUI's execution cache so only repeat previews failed; the user disproved it by changing the prompt and by a fresh-restart first preview also failing. Second finding, product not bug: t2v previews at 5 of 20 steps are unrecognisable while i2v previews are fine, because the i2v keyframe is a condition latent re-injected every step and never denoised. The split is ONE number, SplitSigmas step 5 on node 141 against BasicScheduler steps 20, and it is a true split-sigma continuation so total denoising is 20 steps wherever the split sits - moving it costs preview time and returns exactly that much on Continue. Undecided: raise globally, or make it injectable so t2v splits later than i2v. Regenerate via generate_h3.py, never hand-edit.
